titles.title: A Demon King's Introduction to Married Life

description:
Eric, an orphan boy offered to the Demon King as a sacrifice under the guise of a "bride."

Though he had braced himself to be devoured, the Demon King was dazzlingly beautiful and gentle.   
From that day on, Eric had only one goal: to become the "best bride."

Years later, a much-grown Eric is still striving to become the "perfect bride."   
Then one day, he hears something shocking from his friend John.

"Is kissing...   
always that rough?   
I thought my tongue was going to get ripped out."

...A kiss?   
Even I, his bride, haven't had one yet?!

Unable to take it anymore, Eric storms off to confront the Demon King...

"Hyung, why don't we ever kiss?"

Will Eric truly be able to claim the Demon King's lips?
